title.zh: 卷三十七 本紀第三十七: 寧宗
title.raw: 卷三十七 本紀第三十七: 寧宗 Volume 37 Annals 37: Ningzong

sentences.zh: 寧宗沖聖嗣孝皇帝，諱懿璘質班，明宗第二子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Ningzong Chong Sheng Si Xiao, taboo name Yilianzhen Shiraban, was Mingzong's second son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ningzong Chong Sheng Si Xiao, taboo name Yilianzhen Shiraban, was Mingzong's second son.

sentences.zh: 母曰八不沙皇后，乃蠻真氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Budashiri of the Naiman clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Budashiri of the Naiman clan.

sentences.zh: 初，武宗有子二人，長明宗，次文宗。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wuzong had two sons — the elder Mingzong, the younger Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Wuzong had two sons — the elder Mingzong, the younger Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 延祐中，明宗封周王，出居朔漠。

translations.literal: During Yanyou, Mingzong was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and went out to dwell in the northern desert.
translations.idiomatic: During Yanyou, Mingzong was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and went out to dwell in the northern desert.

sentences.zh: 泰定之際，正統遂偏。

translations.literal: At the time of Taiding, orthodox succession was thereby skewed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time of Taiding, orthodox succession was thereby skewed.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年，文宗入紹大統，內難既平，即遣使奉皇帝璽綬，北迎明宗。

translations.literal: First year of Tianli, Wenzong entered to continue the Great Foundation; once the inner turmoil was pacified, he immediately dispatched envoys bearing the imperial seal and cord to welcome Mingzong from the north.
translations.idiomatic: First year of Tianli, Wenzong entered to continue the Great Foundation; once the inner turmoil was pacified, he immediately dispatched envoys bearing the imperial seal and cord to welcome Mingzong from the north.

sentences.zh: 明宗崩，文宗復即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Mingzong died; Wenzong again ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong died; Wenzong again ascended the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 明宗有子二人，長妥歡帖木耳，次即帝也。

translations.literal: Mingzong had two sons — the elder Toghan Temür, the younger being the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong had two sons — the elder Toghan Temür, the younger being the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 天歷三年二月乙巳，封帝為鄜王。

translations.literal: Third year of Tianli, second month, on yisi day, the Emperor was enfeoffed Prince of Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Third year of Tianli, second month, on yisi day, the Emperor was enfeoffed Prince of Fu.

sentences.zh: 至順三年八月己酉，文宗崩於上都，皇后導揚末命，申固讓初誌，傳位於明宗之子。

translations.literal: Third year of Zhishun, eighth month, on jiyou day, Wenzong died at Shangdu; the empress guided and proclaimed his final command, reiterated the original intent of firm yielding, and transmitted the throne to Mingzong's sons.
translations.idiomatic: Third year of Zhishun, eighth month, on jiyou day, Wenzong died at Shangdu; the empress guided and proclaimed his final command, reiterated the original intent of firm yielding, and transmitted the throne to Mingzong's sons.

sentences.zh: 時妥歡帖木耳出居靜江，帝以文宗眷愛之篤，留京師。

translations.literal: At that time Toghan Temür was residing at Jingjiang; because of Wenzong's deep affection for the Emperor, he remained at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Toghan Temür was residing at Jingjiang; because of Wenzong's deep affection for the Emperor, he remained at the capital.

sentences.zh: 太師、太平王、右丞相燕鐵木兒，請立帝以繼大統。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor, Prince of Taiping, and right chancellor Yan Temür requested that the Emperor be installed to continue the Great Foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor, Prince of Taiping, and right chancellor Yan Temür requested that the Emperor be installed to continue the Great Foundation.

sentences.zh: 於是遣使征諸王會京師，中書百司政務，咸啟中宮取進止。

translations.literal: Thereupon envoys were dispatched to summon the princes to assemble at the capital; the hundred offices of the central secretariat in all governmental affairs reported to the inner palace for approval.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon envoys were dispatched to summon the princes to assemble at the capital; the hundred offices of the central secretariat in all governmental affairs reported to the inner palace for approval.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，中書省臣奉中宮旨，預備大朝會賞賜金銀幣帛等物。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, central secretariat officials received the inner palace's command to prepare gold, silver, silks, and brocades and other goods for the great court assembly rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, central secretariat officials received the inner palace's command to prepare gold, silver, silks, and brocades and other goods for the great court assembly rewards.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，燕鐵木兒奉中宮旨，賜駙馬也不幹子歡忒哈赤、太尉孛蘭奚、句容郡王答鄰答裏、僉事小薛、呵麻剌臺之子禿帖木兒、公主本答裏、諸王醜漢妃公主臺忽都魯、諸王卯澤妃公主完者臺及公主本答裏、徹裏帖木兒等金、銀、幣、鈔有差。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Yan Temür, following the inner palace's command, granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks, and notes to imperial son-in-law Yebuqan's son Huantekha, Grand Master of War Bolanxi, Prince of Jurong Commandery Dalindari, commissioner Xiaoxue, Hamalatai's son Tutemür, Princess Bendali, Princess Taihuduru consort of Prince Chouhan, Princess Wanzhetai consort of Prince Maoza, and again Princess Bendali, Cheritemür, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Yan Temür, following the inner palace's command, granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks, and notes to imperial son-in-law Yebuqan's son Huantekha, Grand Master of War Bolanxi, Prince of Jurong Commandery Dalindari, commissioner Xiaoxue, Hamalatai's son Tutemür, Princess Bendali, Princess Taihuduru consort of Prince Chouhan, Princess Wanzhetai consort of Prince Maoza, and again Princess Bendali, Cheritemür, and others.

sentences.zh: 是月，渾源、雲內二州隕霜殺禾，冀寧路之陽曲、河曲二縣及荊門州皆旱，江水又溢，高郵府之寶應、興化二縣，德安府之雲夢、應城二縣大雨，水。

translations.literal: That month, in Hunyuan and Yunnei the two prefectures frost killed the grain; in Jining Route's Yangqu and Hequ the two counties and Jingmen Prefecture all suffered drought; the Yangzi again overflowed; in Gaoyou Prefecture's Baoying and Xinghua the two counties and Dean Prefecture's Yunmeng and Yingcheng the two counties there was great rain and flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month, in Hunyuan and Yunnei the 2 prefectures frost killed the grain; in Jining Route's Yangqu and Hequ the 2 counties and Jingmen Prefecture all suffered drought; the Yangzi again overflowed; in Gaoyou Prefecture's Baoying and Xinghua the 2 counties and Dean Prefecture's Yunmeng and Yingcheng the 2 counties there was great rain and flooding.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，填星犯太微垣左執法。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on dingchou day, Saturn invaded the Left Enforcement star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on dingchou day, Saturn invaded the Left Enforcement star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，修皇太后儀仗。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the empress dowager's ceremonial regalia was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the empress dowager's ceremonial regalia was repaired.

sentences.zh: 是夜，地震有聲來自北。

translations.literal: That night, an earthquake sounded from the north.
translations.idiomatic: That night, an earthquake sounded from the north.

sentences.zh: 是月，益都路之莒、沂二州，泰安州之奉符縣，濟寧路之魚臺、豐縣，曹州之楚丘縣，平江、常州、鎮江三路，松江府、江陰州，中興路之江陵縣，皆大水。

translations.literal: That month, in Yidu Route's Ju and Yi the two prefectures, Taian Prefecture's Fengfu County, Jining Route's Yutai and Feng Counties, Caozhou's Qiuchu County, Pingjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang the three routes, Songjiang Prefecture, Jiangyin Prefecture, and Zhongxing Route's Jiangling County — all suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month, in Yidu Route's Ju and Yi the 2 prefectures, Taian Prefecture's Fengfu County, Jining Route's Yutai and Feng Counties, Caozhou's Qiuchu County, Pingjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang the 3 routes, Songjiang Prefecture, Jiangyin Prefecture, and Zhongxing Route's Jiangling County — all suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 河南府之洛陽縣旱。

translations.literal: Luoyang County of Henan Prefecture suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang County of Henan Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十月庚子，帝即位於大明殿，大赦天下，詔曰：

translations.literal: Tenth month, on gengzi day, the Emperor ascended the throne in Daming Hall, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and the edict said:
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, on gengzi day, the Emperor ascended the throne in Daming Hall, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and the edict said:

sentences.zh: 洪惟太祖皇帝，啟辟疆宇；

translations.literal: Grandly considering the Taizu Emperor, who opened and extended the realm;
translations.idiomatic: Grandly considering the Taizu Emperor, who opened and extended the realm;

sentences.zh: 世祖皇帝，統一萬方；

translations.literal: the Shizu Emperor, who unified the myriad regions;
translations.idiomatic: the Shizu Emperor, who unified the myriad regions;

sentences.zh: 列聖相承，法度明著。

translations.literal: the successive sagely emperors who inherited one another, with laws and standards clearly established.
translations.idiomatic: the successive sagely emperors who inherited one another, with laws and standards clearly established.

sentences.zh: 我曲律皇帝入纂大統，修舉庶政，動合成法，授大寶位於普顏篤皇帝以及格堅皇帝。

translations.literal: Our Emperor Qutuqtu entered to succeed to the Great Foundation, repaired and raised all government affairs, and in action conformed to law; he bestowed the Great Treasure upon Emperors Buyan Toq and Gegegen.
translations.idiomatic: Our Emperor Qutuqtu entered to succeed to the Great Foundation, repaired and raised all government affairs, and in action conformed to law; he bestowed the Great Treasure upon Emperors Buyan Toq and Gegegen.

sentences.zh: 歷數之歸，實當在我忽都篤皇帝、紥牙篤皇帝，而各播越遼遠。

translations.literal: The mandate of Heaven's return truly rested with Us upon Emperors Qoshila and Jaya'adu, yet each was cast far and wandered in distant lands.
translations.idiomatic: The mandate of Heaven's return truly rested with Us upon Emperors Qoshila and Jaya'adu, yet each was cast far and wandered in distant lands.

sentences.zh: 時則有若燕鐵木兒，建義效忠，戢平內難，以定邦國，協恭推戴紥牙篤皇帝。

translations.literal: At that time there was one such as Yan Temür, who raised righteous loyalty and served with devotion, quelled and pacified inner turmoil, settled the state, and with united reverence supported and installed Emperor Jaya'adu.
translations.idiomatic: At that time there was one such as Yan Temür, who raised righteous loyalty and served with devotion, quelled and pacified inner turmoil, settled the state, and with united reverence supported and installed Emperor Jaya'adu.

sentences.zh: 登極之始，即以讓兄之詔明告天下。

translations.literal: At the beginning of his accession he forthwith made clear to all under Heaven the edict yielding to his elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of his accession he forthwith made clear to all under Heaven the edict yielding to his elder brother.

sentences.zh: 隨奉璽紱，遠迓忽都篤皇帝，朔方言還，奄棄臣庶。

translations.literal: Then bearing the seal and cord he went far to welcome Emperor Qoshila; when word came from the northern frontier that he was returning, he suddenly abandoned his subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Then bearing the seal and cord he went far to welcome Emperor Qoshila; when word came from the northern frontier that he was returning, he suddenly abandoned his subjects.

sentences.zh: 紥牙篤皇帝，薦正宸極，仁義之至，視民如傷，恩澤旁被，無間遠邇。

translations.literal: Emperor Jaya'adu ascended and rectified the imperial throne; his benevolence and righteousness reached the utmost — viewing the people as wounded, his grace spread on every side, without distinction between far and near.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jaya'adu ascended and rectified the imperial throne; his benevolence and righteousness reached the utmost — viewing the people as wounded, his grace spread on every side, without distinction between far and near.

sentences.zh: 顧育眇躬，尤篤慈愛。

translations.literal: In nurturing Our young person he was especially deep in compassionate love.
translations.idiomatic: In nurturing Our young person he was especially deep in compassionate love.

sentences.zh: 賓天之日，皇后傳顧命於太師、太平王、右丞相、答剌罕燕帖木兒，太保、浚寧王、知樞密院事伯顏等，謂聖體彌留，益推固讓之初誌，以宗社之重，屬諸大兄忽都篤皇帝之世嫡。

translations.literal: On the day he ascended to Heaven, the empress transmitted the final command to Grand Preceptor, Prince of Taiping, right chancellor, and dalaqan Yan Temür, Grand Guardian, Prince of Jünning, and privy council administrator Bayan, and others, saying the sacred person was critically lingering and should further advance the original intent of firm yielding; for the weight of altars and state, the charge was placed upon the legitimate heir in the line of the Great Elder Brother Emperor Qoshila.
translations.idiomatic: On the day he ascended to Heaven, the empress transmitted the final command to Grand Preceptor, Prince of Taiping, right chancellor, and dalaqan Yan Temür, Grand Guardian, Prince of Jünning, and privy council administrator Bayan, and others, saying the sacred person was critically lingering and should further advance the original intent of firm yielding; for the weight of altars and state, the charge was placed upon the legitimate heir in the line of the Great Elder Brother Emperor Qoshila.

sentences.zh: 乃遣使召諸王宗親，以十月一日來會於大都，與宗王、大臣同奉遺詔。

translations.literal: Envoys were then dispatched to summon the princes and imperial kin to assemble at Dadu on the first day of the tenth month, jointly to follow the testamentary edict together with the princes and great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were then dispatched to summon the princes and imperial kin to assemble at Dadu on the 1st day of the 10th month, jointly to follow the testamentary edict together with the princes and great ministers.

sentences.zh: 揆諸成憲，宜禦神器，以至順三年十月初四日，即皇帝位於大明殿，可大赦天下。

translations.literal: Measured against the established statutes, he ought to undertake the sacred regalia; on the fourth day of the tenth month of the third year of Zhishun, he ascended the imperial throne in Daming Hall — a general amnesty throughout the realm may be proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Measured against the established statutes, he ought to undertake the sacred regalia; on the 4th day of the 10th month of the third year of Zhishun, he ascended the imperial throne in Daming Hall — a general amnesty throughout the realm may be proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 自至順三年十月初四日昧爽以前，除謀反大逆、謀殺祖父母父母、妻妾殺夫、奴婢殺主、謀故殺人、但犯強盜、印造偽鈔、蠱毒魘魅犯上者不赦外，其餘一切罪犯，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: From before dawn on the fourth day of the tenth month of the third year of Zhishun, except for plotting rebellion or great treason, plotting to kill grandparents or parents, wives or concubines killing husbands, slaves or bondmaids killing masters, plotting deliberate murder, those who committed robbery, forging false notes, or sorcery and malign enchantment offending superiors — all not pardoned — all other crimes whatsoever are pardoned and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: From before dawn on the 4th day of the 10th month of the third year of Zhishun, except for plotting rebellion or great treason, plotting to kill grandparents or parents, wives or concubines killing husbands, slaves or bondmaids killing masters, plotting deliberate murder, those who committed robbery, forging false notes, or sorcery and malign enchantment offending superiors — all not pardoned — all other crimes whatsoever are pardoned and remitted.

sentences.zh: 大都、上都、興和三路，差稅免三年。

translations.literal: In Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe the three routes, corvée tax is remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe the 3 routes, corvée tax is remitted for 3 years.

sentences.zh: 腹裏差發並其餘諸郡不納差發去處，稅糧十分為率，免二分。

translations.literal: Within the metropolitan region, corvée levies and all other commanderies that do not submit corvée levies — grain tax at the rate of ten parts, two parts remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Within the metropolitan region, corvée levies and all other commanderies that do not submit corvée levies — grain tax at the rate of 10 parts, 2 parts remitted.

sentences.zh: 江淮以南，夏稅亦免二分。

translations.literal: South of the Yangzi and Huai, summer tax also has two parts remitted.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Yangzi and Huai, summer tax also has 2 parts remitted.

sentences.zh: 土木工役，除倉庫必合修理外，毋復創造，以紓民力。

translations.literal: Civil engineering labor — except warehouses that must be repaired, no further new construction, to ease the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: Civil engineering labor — except warehouses that must be repaired, no further new construction, to ease the people's strength.

sentences.zh: 民間在前應有逋欠差稅課程，盡行蠲免。

translations.literal: Among the people, all past overdue corvée taxes and levies are entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Among the people, all past overdue corvée taxes and levies are entirely remitted.

sentences.zh: 監察御史、肅政廉訪司官並內外三品以上正官，歲舉才堪守令者一人，申達省部，先行錄用。

translations.literal: Surveillance censors, integrity and investigation officials, and regular officials of the third rank and above within and without — each year recommend one person fit to serve as prefect or magistrate, report upward to the provincial departments, and employ first on record.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance censors, integrity and investigation officials, and regular officials of the 3rd rank and above within and without — each year recommend 1 person fit to serve as prefect or magistrate, report upward to the provincial departments, and employ first on record.

sentences.zh: 如果稱職，舉官優加旌擢。

translations.literal: If they prove competent in office, the recommending official is specially rewarded and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: If they prove competent in office, the recommending official is specially rewarded and promoted.

sentences.zh: 一任之內，或犯贓私者，量其輕重黜罰。

translations.literal: Within one term of office, if they commit corruption for private gain, according to the severity they are dismissed and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Within 1 term of office, if they commit corruption for private gain, according to the severity they are dismissed and punished.

sentences.zh: 其不該原免重囚，淹禁三年以上、疑不能決者，申達省部，詳讞釋放。

translations.literal: Those serious criminals who ought not be pardoned, detained three years or more with doubts preventing decision — report upward to the provincial departments for detailed review and release.
translations.idiomatic: Those serious criminals who ought not be pardoned, detained 3 years or more with doubts preventing decision — report upward to the provincial departments for detailed review and release.

sentences.zh: 學校農桑、孝義貞節、科舉取士、國學貢試，並依舊制。

translations.literal: Schools and agriculture, filial conduct and chaste integrity, examination recruitment of scholars, and National University tribute examinations — all follow the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Schools and agriculture, filial conduct and chaste integrity, examination recruitment of scholars, and National University tribute examinations — all follow the old statutes.

sentences.zh: 廣海、雲南梗化之民，詔書到日，限六十日內出官，與免本罪，許以自新。

translations.literal: Among the recalcitrant peoples of Guanghai and Yunnan, from the day the edict arrives they are limited to sixty days to surrender to officials; their original crimes are remitted and self-renewal is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Among the recalcitrant peoples of Guanghai and Yunnan, from the day the edict arrives they are limited to 60 days to surrender to officials; their original crimes are remitted and self-renewal is permitted.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 肆予沖人，托於天下臣民之上，任大守重，若涉淵冰。

translations.literal: Now I, a young person, am set upon all under Heaven's subjects; the charge is great and the guardianship heavy — like treading upon deep ice.
translations.idiomatic: Now I, a young person, am set upon all under Heaven's subjects; the charge is great and the guardianship heavy — like treading upon deep ice.

sentences.zh: 尚賴宗王大臣、百司庶府，交修乃職，思盡厥忠。

translations.literal: I still rely upon the imperial princes, great ministers, and the hundred offices and many agencies jointly to repair their duties and think to exhaust their loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: I still rely upon the imperial princes, great ministers, and the hundred offices and many agencies jointly to repair their duties and think to exhaust their loyalty.

sentences.zh: 嘉與億兆之民，共保承平之治。

translations.literal: May We together with the hundred millions of the people jointly preserve the governance of enduring peace.
translations.idiomatic: May We together with the hundred millions of the people jointly preserve the governance of enduring peace.

sentences.zh: 咨爾多方，體予至意！

translations.literal: I announce to you of the many regions — embody My utmost intent!
translations.idiomatic: I announce to you of the many regions — embody My utmost intent!

sentences.zh: 故茲詔示，想知悉。

translations.literal: Therefore this edict is proclaimed — let it be known.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore this edict is proclaimed — let it be known.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以知樞密院事撒敦為御史大夫，中書右丞撒迪為中書平章政事，宣政使闊裏吉思為中書左丞，中書平章政事禿兒哈鐵木兒知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, privy council administrator Sadun was made censor-in-chief; central secretariat right vice chancellor Sadi was made central secretariat associate grand councillor; Bureau of Buddhist Affairs commissioner Korqos was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; central secretariat associate grand councillor Toghto Temür was made privy council administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, privy council administrator Sadun was made censor-in-chief; central secretariat right vice chancellor Sadi was made central secretariat associate grand councillor; Bureau of Buddhist Affairs commissioner Korqos was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; central secretariat associate grand councillor Toghto Temür was made privy council administrator.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，造皇太后玉冊、玉寶。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the empress dowager's jade book and jade seal were made.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the empress dowager's jade book and jade seal were made.

sentences.zh: 丁未，皇太后命作兩宮幄殿、車乘、供帳。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the empress dowager ordered the making of canopy halls, carriages, and furnishings for the two palaces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the empress dowager ordered the making of canopy halls, carriages, and furnishings for the 2 palaces.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賞賚諸王金、幣，其數如文宗即位之制。

translations.literal: On wushen day, the princes were rewarded with gold and silks in amounts according to the precedent of Wenzong's accession.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the princes were rewarded with gold and silks in amounts according to the precedent of Wenzong's accession.

sentences.zh: 立徽政、中政二院。

translations.literal: The Huizheng and Central Domestic Affairs Courts were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Huizheng and Central Domestic Affairs Courts were established.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太白犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Venus invaded the Dipper constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Venus invaded the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 敕：「諸王、駙馬、勛舊大臣及中書省、樞密院、御史臺秩正二品，百司庶府秩至一品者，闕門之內，得施繩床以坐，餘皆禁之。

translations.literal: An edict: "Within the palace gates, princes, imperial sons-in-law, meritorious elder ministers, and those of the central secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate at the regular second rank, and the hundred offices and many agencies at the first rank, may use corded couches to sit; all others are forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: An edict: "Within the palace gates, princes, imperial sons-in-law, meritorious elder ministers, and those of the central secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate at the regular 2nd rank, and the hundred offices and many agencies at the 1st rank, may use corded couches to sit; all others are forbidden."

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，修郊祀法服。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, suburban sacrifice ritual garments were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, suburban sacrifice ritual garments were repaired.

sentences.zh: 以宦者鐵古思、哈裏兀答兒、黑狗者、闊闊出並為中政院使。

translations.literal: The eunuchs Tiegu Si, Hari'udar, Heigouzhe, and Kuokuochu were all made commissioners of the Central Domestic Affairs Court.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuchs Tiegu Si, Hari'udar, Heigouzhe, and Kuokuochu were all made commissioners of the Central Domestic Affairs Court.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以江浙歲比不登，其海運糧不及數，俟來歲補運。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, because Jiang-Zhe had several years of poor harvests in succession and sea-transport grain did not reach the quota, it was ordered to be supplemented in the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, because Jiang-Zhe had several years of poor harvests in succession and sea-transport grain did not reach the quota, it was ordered to be supplemented in the coming year.

sentences.zh: 壬子，定婦人犯私鹽罪，著為令。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the crime of women violating private salt regulations was fixed as statute.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the crime of women violating private salt regulations was fixed as statute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，諸王不賽因遣使貢塔裏牙八十八斤、佩刀八十，賜鈔三千三百錠。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Prince Busain dispatched envoys presenting eighty-eight jin of rhinoceros horn and eighty girdle knives; three thousand three hundred ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Prince Busain dispatched envoys presenting 88 jin of rhinoceros horn and 80 girdle knives; 3,300 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以即位告祭南郊。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the accession was announced with sacrifice at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the accession was announced with sacrifice at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，給宿衛士、蒙古、漢軍三萬人禦寒衣。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, winter clothing was issued to thirty thousand palace guardsmen, Mongol troops, and Han troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, winter clothing was issued to 30,000 palace guardsmen, Mongol troops, and Han troops.

sentences.zh: 命江浙行省範銅造和寧宣聖廟祭器，凡百三十有五事。

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to cast bronze ritual vessels for the Heaning Sagely King Temple — one hundred thirty-five items in all.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to cast bronze ritual vessels for the Heaning Sagely King Temple — 135 items in all.

sentences.zh: 己未，告祭太廟。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, sacrifice was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, sacrifice was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚申，告祭社稷。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, sacrifice was announced at the Altar of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, sacrifice was announced at the Altar of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 以伯顏為徽政使，依前開府儀同三司、浚寧王、太保、錄軍國重事、知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Bayan was made Huizheng Court commissioner, continuing as before as Commissioner with the Ceremonial Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, Prince of Jünning, Grand Guardian, recorder of state affairs of military importance, and privy council administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was made Huizheng Court commissioner, continuing as before as Commissioner with the Ceremonial Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, Prince of Jünning, Grand Guardian, recorder of state affairs of military importance, and privy council administrator.

sentences.zh: 提調忠翊侍衛親軍都指揮使司事伯撒裏、右都威衛都指揮使常不蘭奚，並為徽政使。

translations.literal: Superintendent of the Loyal Support Palace Guard Personal Army Commander-in-Chief's Office Barsari and Right Capital Might Guard commander-in-chief Changbolanxi were both made Huizheng Court commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Superintendent of the Loyal Support Palace Guard Personal Army Commander-in-Chief's Office Barsari and Right Capital Might Guard commander-in-chief Changbolanxi were both made Huizheng Court commissioners.

sentences.zh: 賜諸妃後大朝會賞賚有差。

translations.literal: The consorts and imperial concubines were granted graded rewards for the great court assembly.
translations.idiomatic: The consorts and imperial concubines were granted graded rewards for the great court assembly.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以諸王忽剌臺貧乏，賜鈔五百錠。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, because Prince Hulatai was impoverished, five hundred ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because Prince Hulatai was impoverished, 500 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 皇弟燕帖古思受戒於西僧加兒麻哇。

translations.literal: The Emperor's younger brother Yanq Tegus received precepts from the western monk Garmawa.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's younger brother Yanq Tegus received precepts from the western monk Garmawa.

sentences.zh: 敕：「百官及宿衛士有只孫衣者，凡與宴饗，皆服以侍。

translations.literal: An edict: "Among the hundred officials and palace guardsmen who possess zhisun garments, whenever they attend banquets and feasts they shall all wear them in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict: "Among the hundred officials and palace guardsmen who possess zhisun garments, whenever they attend banquets and feasts they shall all wear them in attendance.

sentences.zh: 其或質諸人者，罪之。

translations.literal: Those who pawn them to others are guilty of a crime."
translations.idiomatic: Those who pawn them to others are guilty of a crime."

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，楚丘縣河堤壞，發民丁二千三百五十人修之。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, the river dike at Qiuchu County was breached; two thousand three hundred fifty corvée laborers were mobilized to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the river dike at Qiuchu County was breached; 2,350 corvée laborers were mobilized to repair it.
